integrity: Analytic proof with a self-contained reproducibility program; computations corroborate but do not establish the all-orders theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies to existing finite projective planes, possibly non-Desarguesian; no assertion of existence at arbitrary order. Finite numerical checks cover prime orders 2,3,5,7. An equivalent older association-scheme specialization is a residual originality risk.
title: Dual negative-type thresholds for projective-plane incidence and nonincidence metrics
